Class UtilizatorDbRepository

java.lang.Object
repository.UtilizatorDbRepository
All Implemented Interfaces:
Repository<Integer, Utilizator>
public class UtilizatorDbRepository extends Object implements Repository<Integer, Utilizator>
Database repository for users (PostgreSQL, table users), implemented with JDBC. The id of a new user is generated by the database.
